jobs.prompt: Create ONE transparent isolated side-view game shop BACKDROP asset, no NPC no desk no ground strip. Image1 is exact color/style authority: pale ivory paper monochrome graphite sketch village. Match its very pale stone fill and thin subdued gray-brown lines, NOT dark beige paint. Image2 is structure arrangement reference restore its charming broad broken stone wall, cloth canopy on wooden beams, modest hanging palette sign, climbing leaf clusters, low side walls BOTH sides, short wooden fences and one barrel and crate on outer sides. A coherent wide shop frontage, frontal 2D elevation no perspective. Center recess empty for separate 120px tall merchant and desk. Entire structure intended 390px wide 230px high at game resolution, broad readable shapes few marks per stone, not miniature realistic noise. Lantern ON with bright amber core and restrained warm pool ON central wall only; outer stones remain pale monochrome like image1. Transparent exterior, no sky, no surrounding scene, no label, all fence ends and barrel bottoms fully contained. Flat baseline. Preserve actual sketch game aesthetic.

Create ONE transparent isolated shop BACKDROP for side scrolling pixel game. Image1 exact low saturation dark blue green wall style authority. Image2 arrangement inspiration: restore substantial overhead thick iron pipe with elbows and coupling bands, mossy stone service niche, hanging palette sign, ON amber lantern casting local warm pool onto niche. No NPC no desk no floor. Entire structure large width about 1.4 times height, dominant center empty alcove to fit large broad axolotl merchant. Pipe brackets and modest side utility fittings, readable big forms. STRICT frontal orthographic 2D. Match existing wall block scale and matte colors. No black drawn contours, no realistic noisy texture, no smooth 3D bevels. Pixel clusters sparse highlights. Interior dark muted, amber only around lamp. All pipe endpoints capped or return into side walls, no abruptly chopped edges. Exterior transparent, no surrounding background or text.

Extract and redraw ONLY the RIGHT 2 STAGE axolotl merchant as one isolated full body transparent sprite. Preserve broad squat dark navy ink axolotl, three pale sage tipped gill fins per side, sleepy half lidded amber eyes, cream throat, olive work apron with faded plum rag, pouch, curling thick tail. No left cat, no desk, no background, no text or symbols. Match a low resolution 2D action game protagonist: very simple solid pixel clusters, about 80x96 logical pixel character enlarged nearest-neighbor, 2 or 3 flat colors per material maximum. No outline strokes anywhere including gills and apron, dark body is solid fill not contour. No soft gradients, grain, tiny hatching, realistic shading. Friendly bored shopkeeper neutral standing pose facing slightly left but full side-scroller front-three-quarter sprite, hands relaxed. True alpha transparency.

data.npc1: Edit the attached horned ink merchant sprite, preserve identity, pose, silhouette, apron, crescent horns and rag. Cream horns have NO drawn border; black body is solid ink fill. Ochre apron solid planes and one simple pocket, no intricate seam shading. Gold rectangular eyes. Small stout feet. Whole body fully visible on true transparent background. Intended display height 120 pixels, not high resolution illustration. No table or scene. Keep friendly gesture.
